metadata.title: J E J U, A Private Island Companion
metadata.weather_notes: April: cherry blossoms, 14-19 deg C, occasional spring showers

daily_schedule.theme: Chill Arrival - Brunch, Coffee, Check In, Breathe
daily_schedule.base_zone: Aewol -> South Coast -> The Grand Sumorum
daily_schedule.drive_route: Airport -> Noraba (Aewol) (25 min) - Noraba -> Slow Boat (10 min) - Slow Boat -> Hotel (The Grand Sumorum) (50 min)

stops.name: Jeju International Airport
stops.note: Pick up rental car. Have IDP + home licence ready.

stops.name: Noraba
stops.note: Brunch spot. ~25 min from airport.

stops.name: Slow Boat
stops.note: Coffee with ocean view. ~10 min from Noraba.

stops.name: The Grand Sumorum
stops.note: Check in. ~50 min from Slow Boat.

daily_schedule.drive_route: Hotel -> Seongsan Port (50 min) - Seongsan Port -> Memil Makguksu (Andeok) (55 min) - Memil Makguksu -> Hotel (25 min)

stops.name: Seongsan Port
stops.note: Ferry to Udo Island. Phone: +82-64-782-5671. Book ferry in advance.

stops.name: Udo Island
stops.note: Scenic island. Rent scooters or bicycles on the island. ~15 min ferry ride.

stops.name: Seongsan Ilchulbong
stops.note: UNESCO sunrise peak. Arrive before 9am to beat crowds. ₩5,000 entry.

stops.name: Memil Makguksu
stops.note: Famous buckwheat noodle restaurant. ~55 min from Seongsan.

daily_schedule.base_zone: Oiljang Market -> West Loop - O'sulloc, Camellia & Fine Dining
daily_schedule.drive_route: Hotel -> Jeju City Folk Market (45 min) - Jeju City Market -> Jejudang (Aewol) (15 min) - Jejudang -> O'sulloc (30 min) - O'sulloc -> Camellia Hill (5 min) - Camellia Hill -> Jungmun Beach (15 min) - Jungmun -> Sukseongdo + Hotel (15 min)

stops.name: Jeju City Folk Market (Oiljang)
stops.note: Traditional 5-day market. Opens early. Local snacks + produce.

stops.name: Jejudang
stops.note: Trendy cafe. ~15 min from market.

stops.name: O'sulloc Tea Museum
stops.note: Famous green tea estate + museum. Free entry to museum. ~30 min from Jejudang.

stops.name: Camellia Hill
stops.note: 2,000+ camellia trees in bloom. ₩9,000 entry. ~5 min from O'sulloc.

stops.name: Jungmun Beach
stops.note: Scenic beach. ~15 min from Camellia Hill.

stops.name: Sukseongdo Restaurant
stops.note: Fine dining near hotel. ~15 min from Jungmun.

daily_schedule.base_zone: Seogwipo South - Waterfalls, Market & Haenyeo Table
daily_schedule.drive_route: Hotel -> Cheonjiyeon Falls (15 min) - Cheonjiyeon -> Maeil Olle Market (5 min) - Market -> Gossine Noodles (5 min) - After lunch -> Seogwipo coastal walk (5 min) - Coastal walk -> Haemultang dinner (10 min)

stops.name: Cheonjiyeon Falls
stops.note: Three-tiered waterfall. 15 min walk from car park. ₩2,500 entry.

stops.name: Maeil Olle Market
stops.note: Daily local market in Seogwipo city. ~5 min from falls.

stops.name: Gossine
stops.note: Famous noodle spot. ~5 min from market.

stops.name: Seogwipo Coastal Walk
stops.note: Scenic clifftop walk with ocean views. ~5 min from lunch.

stops.name: Haemultang Restaurant
stops.note: Haenyeo-style seafood hotpot dinner. ~10 min from walk.

daily_schedule.base_zone: Jeongbang Falls -> Jeju City -> Object Jeju -> Airport
daily_schedule.drive_route: Hotel -> Jeongbang Waterfall (10 min) - Jeongbang -> Tapdong Promenade (Jeju City) (45 min) - Tapdong -> Object Jeju (35 min) - Object Jeju -> Airport (car return) (30 min)
daily_schedule.note: Flight at 1:25 PM. Be at airport by 11:30 AM. Return car before check-in.

stops.name: Jeongbang Waterfall
stops.note: Waterfall that falls directly into the ocean. One of a kind. ₩2,000 entry. 10 min from hotel.

stops.name: Tapdong Promenade
stops.note: Seaside promenade + windmill. ~45 min from Jeongbang.

stops.name: Object Jeju
stops.note: Curated Jeju souvenir shop. ~35 min from Tapdong.

stops.name: Jeju International Airport
stops.note: Return rental car. Depart 1:25 PM. ~30 min from Object Jeju.
